standard: A senior marketer plus a video director would publish this under their own name and the owner would not need to correct it.

tasks.prompt: Produce a 30 s silent Hebrew 16:9 site video for the product shown on the portfolio card as 'AI Agent System' (Yotam's multi-agent end-to-end software development system with self-improvement, hosted in his own n8n; benchmark task only, not for publication), from its true source, plus brief, script and a one-paragraph next experiment.

Plan one week of marketing for the business itself and Yotam's capabilities: positioning in 3 lines, 3 post drafts, one experiment, and an analysis of the supplied insights fixture (agents/benchmarks/marketing/fixtures/insights-demo.json), stating what the numbers do and do not support.

rubric.q: One promise a stranger can repeat after 5 seconds

anchors.5: a cold viewer states the promise correctly

rubric.q: Every claim traces to a verified claim id; no invented numbers, customers or reviews

anchors.5: all traced, nothing invented, demo data labelled

rubric.q: Sells what the product really does; no internal status or limitation stated as a negative

anchors.5: no negatives, no apologies, no inflated promises

rubric.q: Names the buyer's real pain in the buyer's words

anchors.5: specific pain a business owner would say out loud

rubric.q: Smooth motion, readable at card size, nothing snaps or ends frozen
Hypothesis, angles A/B/C with trade-offs, decision, success metric
Conclusions from numbers with denominators; small samples called 'no signal'

anchors.5: every claim has n and a stated limit; ignores noise

checks.cmd: ! grep -rEil 'לא מוכן|not production|not yet proven|עדיין לא הוכח' {out_dir}

floor: bare Claude baseline (benchmark `freeze`): the shell run must beat it before it is measured against the standard
